name: bmcptools
description: An MCP server exposing 44 developer tools (file I/O, shell execution, search, system info, and interactive user dialogs) to any MCP-compatible LLM client.

filesystem.reason: File, multi-file, directory, and search tools read and modify paths the user/agent targets. Destructive operations (delete, overwrite, recursive remove) are gated and marked with destructive annotations.

shell.reason: run_command runs bounded, non-interactive local commands. No PTY is allocated and there is no auto-elevation.

network.reason: http_request and download_file perform caller-initiated HTTP requests. Private, loopback, and link-local targets are blocked unless allow_private is explicitly set.

environment.reason: get_env inspects environment variables. Without an explicit key/filter it lists names only, and secret-like values are redacted by default.

clipboard.reason: clipboard_read and clipboard_write access the system clipboard on request; reads are size-capped.

process.reason: list_processes inspects running processes; it does not start or kill processes.

network.notes: No telemetry, analytics, or hardcoded outbound endpoints. Every network call is explicitly requested by the caller and SSRF-guarded by default.

dataHandling.notes: bmcptools does not collect, store, or transmit user data on its own. Output is bounded by default caps to avoid leaking large or sensitive content.
